text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days before the Takarazuka Kinen, Sakura Chiyono O makes some final adjustments for the race with the help of Maruzensky, the Umamusume she idolizes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O explains that it was thanks to her rivals that she's been able to make her return to racing. Hearing this, Maruzensky beams and wishes her every success at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen arrives. As Mejiro Ardan, Yaeno Muteki, and Sakura Chiyono O celebrate their reunion, they're approached by Inari One, a racer whose recent feats have been remarkable indeed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One throws down the gauntlet for the three of them, and Mejiro Ardan senses from this new foe's formidable aura that there's more to her than bluster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, not a single one of the three racers feels intimidated by Inari One. In fact, as they prepare to race, they're elated by the prospect of facing such a strong opponent.
